# Error codes

Every error response is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body with a machine-readable
`code`. Validation errors add `violations[]` (JSON Pointers into the request body and the
schema); rendering errors add `diagnostics[]` (message, file, line, column, hints). Files
inside a bundled package are shown as `@preview/<name>:<version>/<path>`.

| HTTP status | `code` | Title |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid-json` | Invalid JSON |
| 400 | `invalid-parameter` | Invalid parameter |
| 404 | `template-not-found` | Template not found |
| 409 | `template-invalid` | Template invalid |
| 413 | `payload-too-large` | Payload too large |
| 415 | `unsupported-media-type` | Unsupported media type |
| 422 | `validation-failed` | Validation failed |
| 500 | `render-failed` | Render failed |
| 503 | `overloaded` | Overloaded |
| 504 | `render-timeout` | Render timeout |
